title: Lula Promises University Version of Pé de Meia Program if Reelected
seoTitle: Lula Promises University Version of Pé de Meia
subtitle: President announces program expansion for higher education students in a potential new term
excerpt: In an official announcement, Lula promises a university version of the Pé de Meia social program if he wins reelection.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, running for reelection, announced this Tuesday (13) his intention to create a version of the Pé de Meia social program specifically tailored for university students if elected for another term.

Purpose of the proposal

The initiative aims to adapt the benefits currently provided by the original program, which traditionally assists low-income families, to meet the needs of young adults entering higher education. The proposal includes expanding financial assistance and academic support measures, aligned with public policies on social inclusion.

Context of the Pé de Meia program

Pé de Meia is a cash transfer program designed to guarantee a minimum income for vulnerable families, contributing to poverty reduction and promoting citizenship. Extending it to the university level represents an adjustment in social assistance policy, seeking to support a group that, despite pursuing higher education, may still face economic hardship.

The announcement was made as part of his reelection campaign, highlighting the continuity and expansion of social policies as key elements of the candidate's platform if elected for a new term.

With information from Agência Brasil.
